required_assumptions: x != y for the divided-difference branch

proof_obligations.expected: G0002 == Derivative(F(z), z) evaluated at z=x
limit(G0001, y->x) == G0002 under the differentiability assumption

hypotheses.scientific_rationale: The piecewise expression joins the first divided difference of f with the derivative branch at x=y. Both branches arise from the same underlying univariate function f, with the derivative branch being the local/confluent limit of the divided-difference branch.
